scope: Public-Git 14-row G4 notebook: independently measured ESM and warm prediction stages with raw precision evidence; dependency repair and retained ESM are recorded separately

resume_provenance.initial_failure: UnsupportedKinetics: Base runtime must have a matching accepted certificate

esm_stage.boundary: Fresh ESM features with local checkpoint loading, model construction, GPU transfer, original tokenization and batches of four, FP32 forwards, CPU outputs and application-cache writes; synchronized before and after. Downloads, imports, outer preflight validation, precision checks, evidence serialization and model release are excluded. Local filesystem caches are not flushed. The accepted loader's internal metadata checks remain inside the timer. This is not an end-to-end cold request.

feature_validation: Every unique NPZ raw ESM tensor was decoded and compared as FP32 bytes, including signed zero; canonical original feature identities bind the warm prediction requests.
publication_transformations: Local checkout prefixes replaced with repository-relative paths.
Unrelated runtime identifiers replaced with a count.
